parameters.keep_predicate: splitmix64(frame_order ^ seed) < floor(2^64 * R / N), N = sampling-plan stream length

selected_estimator.persistent_state_bytes_per_pixel_channel: min(N, R) * sizeof(ForwardDrizzleV2RobustCandidate) <= 64 * 24 = 1536 plus uniform totals

measured_worst_case.vs_truth_note: worst truth deviation is the bimodal case where the selected estimator reproduces the production oracle exactly (mode collapse to 98.0); the estimator itself never deviates from the oracle by more than 0.036

grouped_contamination_30pct_N600.note: every median-of-means variant fails this production-N case (dev 2.32-2.75) because periodic contamination spreads over all K groups; the per-frame reservoir clip resolves it

clean_gauss_N600.note: reported not gated: quantifies the subsample statistical cost at production N (~64 of 600 frames decide the value)

key_evidence.sparse_and_empty_fallbacks: too_few_candidates_fallback and no_source_support verified; no case loses support

replay_conflict_resolution: the dense scatter emits each frame-local plane once; the selected estimator is a true single-pass stream: per frame it (a) accumulates the uniform A/B/B2 totals, (b) applies the O(1) hash keep predicate and pushes kept (x,b,frame_order) into the bounded reservoir. No candidate replay, no host contribution records, no second enumeration. The final clip runs once per pixel/channel at fold time on <= R records.

estimator_b_mapping.contract: estimator_b = source_b for every frame; the reservoir decides the value only, never the weight
estimator_b_mapping.rationale: B/B2 accumulate the full candidate stream, so Gate-2 estimator support equals source support and n_eff = B^2/B2 counts every contributing frame; clipping affects the value, not the weight sum

fallback_state_machine.no_source_support: no candidate with finite x and b>0; all outputs zero; support not fabricated
fallback_state_machine.too_few_candidates_fallback: valid stream candidates < min_candidates OR kept reservoir < min_clip_contributors; value = weighted Uniform over the full stream, B/B2 full stream
fallback_state_machine.primary_reservoir_sigma_clip: reservoir clip ran; degenerate MAD inside the clip collapses the bounds to the median instead of erroring (mirrors production robust_clip_core: no epsilon padding)
fallback_state_machine.degenerate_scale_too_few_groups: reachable only via the non-selected MoM candidates; documented for completeness, unused by the selected estimator
fallback_state_machine.invariant: every path preserves b > 0 and finite value whenever at least one valid candidate exists

rejected_candidates.mom_weighted_median: fails the frozen 2.0 bound on grouped_contamination_30pct (N=40 and N=600); best MoM variant otherwise
rejected_candidates.mom_winsorized_groups: same grouped-contamination failure; inflated MAD admits contaminated group means
rejected_candidates.mom_trimmed_groups: same failure plus it drops weights (estimator_b mapping would need per-group admission bits)
rejected_candidates.two_pass_winsorized_frames: fails the bound AND violates the single-pass dense-scatter constraint; retained as robust_reduce_v2 quality reference only
rejected_candidates.uniform: reference fallback, not a robust estimator

known_limitations: for N > R the value is decided by a deterministic ~64-frame subsample; statistical cost on clean data measured at 0.06 absolute (clean_gauss_N600, sigma=1 inputs)
a hash-aligned adversarial contamination pattern could bias the subsample; splitmix64(frame_order ^ fixed_seed) makes this non-accidental but not impossible; documented residual risk
reservoir storage of up to 64 records per pixel/channel is a Gate-5 memory input; K-group state is NOT additionally required because no MoM candidate was selected

the oracle's asymmetric sigma_low/sigma_high and min_clip_contributors/passes are carried over from production defaults; per-run configurability is a Gate-7 decision, not a new user-facing parameter here
GPU implementation of the reservoir + clip is deferred to Gate 6; the estimator contract is device-agnostic

verification.determinism: every case x estimator run twice, bit-identical value/b/b2/n_eff/state required and verified
verification.nonfinite_handling: NaN x, inf x, b=0, b=-1 candidates ignored; outputs finite; support preserved

build.note: dirty tree is the Gate-3 implementation itself; the decision commit will bind the clean SHA

deferred_to_later_gates: Gate 5: memory budget for the reservoir planes (<= 64 * 24 B per pixel/channel on device)
Gate 6: device-side reservoir accumulation and per-pixel clip kernel integrated with dense scatter
Gate 7: user-facing parameters if any (none added by this gate)
